summary: Ituran Location and Control Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 25, 2026, disclosing its receipt of an Israeli Tax Authority ruling on withholding tax procedures for a previously announced $0.50 per share dividend (approx. $10M total) payable July 8, 2026. The ruling may allow certain shareholders a reduced withholding tax rate (instead of the standard 25-30%). This is purely a procedural update on a routine dividend, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change.
